tasks.label: daftcron: status  (check everything)
tasks.detail: Telegram, IMAP, the launchd schedule, last run, and database counts.

tasks.label: daftcron: ingest  (run now)
tasks.detail: Find new listings and send Telegram alerts. Skips anything already seen.

tasks.label: daftcron: ingest --dry-run
tasks.detail: Score and rank everything but send no alerts. Use to check without buzzing your phone.

tasks.label: daftcron: top 10
tasks.detail: The current ranking, in the terminal.

tasks.label: daftcron: report + open
tasks.detail: Regenerate out/report.html and open it in the browser.

tasks.label: daftcron: stats
tasks.detail: Run history and coverage from the database.

tasks.label: daftcron: check-imap
tasks.detail: Verify Gmail access without processing or marking anything read.

tasks.label: daftcron: test-telegram
tasks.detail: Send a test message to your phone.

tasks.label: daftcron: cadence
tasks.detail: How Daft sends alerts, and whether the parser is coping with the real format.

tasks.label: daftcron: launchd — is it loaded?
tasks.detail: PID, last exit status, and label. Exit status 0 means the last run was clean.
tasks.command: launchctl list | grep daftcron || echo 'NOT LOADED — nothing runs automatically'

tasks.label: daftcron: logs — recent activity
tasks.detail: Tail the run log and show any errors.
tasks.command: tail -25 out/daftcron.log; echo; echo '--- errors ---'; cat out/daftcron.err

tasks.label: daftcron: reload the launchd job
tasks.detail: Reinstall the plist and reload it. Run this after editing the plist.
tasks.command: cp ie.atensai.daftcron.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ie.atensai.daftcron.plist 2>/dev/null; launchctl load -w ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ie.atensai.daftcron.plist && launchctl list | grep daftcron
